title: A brand-new member can be told 'Home, History and Progress moved', though they never saw the old Home
what: The one-time note 'Home, History and Progress now live under Workout and Profile' is switched on by the update for any phone whose database was made by the version before the 3 tabs, whether or not anyone had set the app up. A phone that was on the welcome screen at that time (installed but never set up, or wiped with Erase all data on the older version) keeps the note waiting. Setting up the app does not clear it, so the new member's first Workout tab shows a note about a move they never saw.
expected: The note shows only to a member who used the app before the 3 tabs; a member who sets up for the first time after the update never sees it.
how_often: rare: only a phone left on the welcome screen across that update
fix_line: Switch the moved-tabs note on only when the phone already had a profile, or clear it when setup is saved

items.reason: Fresh install and update: the base tables are create-if-missing, new columns are added one by one with a check first and the version is stamped only after all are there, so a kill mid-update heals; any open or update failure lands on the error screen, never a half-updated app; a failed read never shows the welcome over real data. The first-run date is written once and kept by Erase. Older backups are restored the old way and the one-time repairs re-run after a restore. Settings saved by older versions are merged with new defaults. One package for every build (no sideload vs Play split in this area). Known faults reused: start-up waits for repairs, two repairs fail without trace, start-up failures not reported, library update fails silently. Watch-and-phone versions and a newer backup restored on an older phone live outside this area (tracker/native, src/backup). Panel cache does not apply to the phone app. The AI model chosen in an old version is kept for ever, but the coach is switched off, so no member is affected now.

Year end and leap day: every day sum in this area goes through the phone's own calendar (add days, week start Monday), so 28 Feb + 1 = 29 Feb in a leap year and 31 Dec rolls to 1 Jan. Gym closes or removes the member, and Leave gym: the gym's look is dropped and MettleUp's comes back, waiting until no workout is open; a gym that drops to a plan without branding loses its look. Owner changes phone: the phone number sign-in finds the owner again. App not opened for 6 months: the one-time repairs and library update run at the next start, saved setup answers are checked before use. Known faults reused: a staff person found by number keeps every paid feature after leaving the gym (staff leaves), and Erase keeps the free month's start day (trial end). Trial and plan end screens themselves live outside this area.

New-only flows found: phone number sign-in and going straight into the gym (welcome only, so only a phone with no profile), the 'We set you up' note (straight-in members only, by design), setup answers kept while setting up (new members only, by design). Existing members never see the welcome after an update.

Existing members have a path: Find my gym on the Gym tab (same WhatsApp check, opens while MettleUp Plus is on), the staff door card for owners and staff, Join with a gym code at any time, and the phone number backup in Settings.
Rule applied: every new-only flow has a path for existing members, so no finding.

What's new: a fresh install has no last-seen version, so it shows nothing and the hints for updated phones stay off. Intro screens: only before the welcome, so a new install sees them and an updated member never does. Moved-tabs note: meant for updated phones only, but also reaches a member who sets up for the first time on a phone that sat on the welcome screen across that update.
Rule applied: the moved-tabs note can show to a member for whom nothing moved.
